name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed_partition
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), p.length < M7.PrefixBits.depth N → M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p = M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [false]) ∪ M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [true]) ∧ Disjoint (M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [false])) (M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [true]))
guidance: Actual completed is the decodePair image of PrefixBits.completed. Apply the accepted natural completed_partition then image_union. For disjointness, two equal decoded members have equal natural supports by ResiduePrefix.decode_injective, using completed_bounds and PrefixBits.base (N>0 follows NeZero). Then apply natural child disjointness. Do not assume image injectivity without its verified bounds. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.
